title: Protect development certificate passwords from files and command lines
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that New-MemorySmithDevCert.ps1 writes a PFX password to plaintext and Redeploy-MemorySmithService.ps1 passes it as a Kestrel command-line argument. Evidence: Scripts/New-MemorySmithDevCert.ps1 line 159 and Scripts/Redeploy-MemorySmithService.ps1 line 561. Use certificate-store/thumbprint or protected secret bindings and remove plaintext/password-argument handling.
